text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria, hematuria, nitrites, and leukocyte esterase positivity. The presence of glucose in urine is abnormal and may suggest hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low urine specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI management and assessment for possible diabetes.
